architecture.notes: Empty directory: `ls src app lib` and a find for features/modules/pages returned nothing, there is no package.json and no tsconfig.json, so there was nothing to follow (references/architecture.md §1). Proposed §2's default layout, adapted to the user's requirement that the app live under app/. No component catalog resolves for this screen (0/61 by key), so shared-vs-feature is a judgement call, not a derived fact: the shell (Sidebar/Header/Footer/AppShell) and the generic list primitives (Button, SquareButton, SearchInput, DataTable, Pagination, Modal, PageTitle, Icon) are shared because the Figma frame builds them from components the other Org-management screens reuse; only jobRoles data and the screen itself are feature-local.

TWO Figma variables are named 'Space 4' (key e26d50…={Mode 1:24}, key 64928e3a…={Desktop:16}). THIS screen binds the 24 one (button + table-row horizontal padding measures 24 in the export). tokens.js run on design/export/variables.json merges them and emits 16 — wrong here — so the theme was generated from design/export/design-system/tokens.json instead, which emits 24.

Same collision class: tokens.js on EITHER variables.json or the screen's own vars.json emits --spacing-space-3: 12px because '(Space 3)'=12 sanitises onto the same custom property and wins silently. Generated from the design system instead, where Space 3 = 16 — which is what the export's own row padding (16) shows.

INVENTED SUFFIX '-paren'. Figma's name is literally '(Space 3)'; parentheses are illegal in a CSS custom property and the generator's own sanitised name collides with the design system's 'Space 3'. Renamed in app/src/theme/theme.screen-tokens.css with the reason inline.

verification.renderer: Playwright 1.47 / Chromium, Vite dev server in Docker at http://localhost:5173/job-roles, viewport 1440x1236
deltas: verify-screen.js --compare: 2 high, 77 medium. Both 'high' rows are the verifier being wrong, not the build: (a) node I20173:137669;45:1743 (' Vector', the moon glyph) — the export's FILL is compared against CSS background-color, and an inline SVG's colour is not a background; (b) node 20173:142096 ('Table row') — expected #46464f because the designer drew that row in its HOVER state; the build renders the resting state and shows #46464f on hover (verified in scripts-test/interact.mjs).

Most 'medium' rows are width/height on containers that are fluid by design (the frame is one viewport, not a canvas): e.g. Frame 1000004145 expected 247 wide, actual 280 (the sidebar's inner column is measured with its padding).
Table header text case: the export sets font.case='title' on 'NO. of Employees' / 'NO. of Units' / 'Manage DOO'; CSS `capitalize` is applied but Chromium leaves 'of' lowercase. Cosmetic.

The screen shows 20 rows per page because the design's own pagination text says 'Showing 1 to 20 of 95', while the frame draws only 12 rows. The label was treated as authoritative and the content column scrolls.

'57 components never built' and '0/28 interactions confirmed' in the report are artifacts of the measurement file: the probe in scripts-test/measure.mjs records computed styles only. The 11 designed/derived interactions were driven separately and all pass (scripts-test/interact.mjs).
